open_points.subject: read_expense_document
open_points.text: - read_expense_document: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST obtain the AuthorizedBinaryReference from _authorize_document_reference, whose read transaction is already closed when it returns, and only then call read_binary; it MUST NOT open a transaction of its own, hold any transaction open across the binary object read, or reach persistence directly.
open_points.other_text: - read_expense_document: [VALIDATION_ERROR] Its transaction guard MUST track transaction open state in a caller-local boolean flag, catch BaseException, rollback only while that flag still marks the transaction open, and re-raise the original failure unchanged; catching only Exception, leaving a transaction neither committed nor rolled back on any path, a second rollback on an already closed transaction, and probing open state through assert_open or a caught PersistenceError are forbidden.
open_points.question: Must read_expense_document open and locally guard a transaction, or must the transaction-guard requirement be removed because the function is forbidden from opening or directly accessing one?
